articleTitle: Flow based analysis of Advanced Persistent Threats detecting targeted attacks in cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Cloud computing provides industry, government, and academic users' convenient and cost-effective access to distributed services and shared data via the Internet. Due to its distribution of diverse users and aggregation of immense data, cloud computing has increasingly been the focus of targeted attacks. Meta-analysis of industry studies and retrospective research involving cloud service providers reveal that cloud computing is demonstrably vulnerable to a particular type of targeted attack, Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs). APTs have proven to be difficult to detect and defend against in cloud based infocommunication systems. The prevalent use of polymorphic malware and encrypted covert communication channels make it difficult for existing packet inspecting and signature based security technologies such as; firewalls, intrusion detection sensors, and anti-virus systems to detect APTs. In this paper, we examine the application of an alternative security approach which applies an algorithm derived from flow based monitoring to successfully detect APTs. Results indicate that statistical modeling of APT communications can successfully develop deterministic characteristics for detection is a more effective and efficient way to protect against APTs.

articleTitle: Optimization model for multi-time period LTE network planning
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: An optimization model for the LTE RAN network planning problem is described. Parameters such as depends, the cost of installation and usage of equipment, the specific income from providing services may change over time in the given optimization model. The analysis of experiment's results showed that formulation of the problem, which is shown above and presented as a problem of MILP, allows to obtain the correct solutions from the practical point of view. Comparison of the operator's profit during the single-period and multi-period planning showed that usage of multi-period planning increase the profit margin to 12% more than the single-period planning.

articleTitle: The increasing convergence of coordination procedure in the implementation of multipath hierarchical routing
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: To avoid overload of links, as well as packet loss in the network uses the coordination method. This method is based on the possibility of converting the original minimization problem in a simpler maximization problem and the solution of this problem using a two-level iterative computational structure. In this paper the analysis of convergence of the two-level hierarchical routing method with coordination is given.

articleTitle: Traffic aggregation and EPS network planning problem
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The following paper presents the solution of such problems as the choice of mathematical models of group and individual traffic in EPS network and method of determining flow parameters at their aggregation. Pro-posed expressions are correct both for self-similar traffic and for Poisson traffic case. As a result of simulation proved the accuracy of the proposed method of determining the traffic parameters when aggregate self-similar traffics. The error in determining the Hurst parameters does not exceed 2%.

articleTitle: System for increasing quality of service of multimedia data in convergent networks
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The important requirement for multiservice network is ensuring QoS indexes which significantly differ for each type of traffic. Since multimedia traffic is characterized with high burstiness and cyclic oscillation of time trend, a problem of network overload appears. Its solution requires new traffic engineering methods based on both statistical and prognosticated data. In this article algorithms of network load prognostication and technique for traffic class determination have been developed. The model of the network that is under investigation has been built. This model allows to verify functioning of prognostic traffic engineering system with evaluation of QoS parameters when deploying MPQ (Modified Priority Queuing). A mathematical model for overload prevention based on generation of traffic of messages with different length, intensity, priority and packets count in the message has been suggested.

articleTitle: Method for transfer of data with intermediate storage
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: There is provided an innovative approach of store and forward transfer. This technique can be effective when long-distance bulk transmission of data in infocommunication networks with low bit-rate sections.

articleTitle: Method of slow-attack detection
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The analysis of realization low-intensity HTTP-attacks was performed. Were described scenarios of Slowloris, Slow POST and Slow READ attack. Features of this type of attacks in comparison with low-level attacks such as “denial of service” were selected: they do not require a large number of resources from the attacking machine, and they are difficult for the detection, since their parameters are similar to legitimate traffic. For each type of attacks the characteristic features were highlighted. Parameters of http-request, which assume the detection of this type attacks high-lighted. The analysis of mathematical tools of building the models for the systems for these types of attacks detection on the basis of the obtained parameters was performed.

articleTitle: Research of queue management model that includes congestion avoidance mechanism
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The following paper presents queue management model that includes congestion avoidance mechanism and suitable for using on telecommunication network nodes. Within the proposed model on a network node consistently was solved Congestion Management and Congestion Avoidance tasks. At the same time general queue management task was reduced to solving of optimization problem. Within the congestion avoidance mechanism packets were dropped in order to prevent node buffer and link overload. Proposed mathematical model was investigated with analytical modeling methods.

articleTitle: Calculation method for power consumption and lifetime of nodes in WSN
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Modern manufacturing techniques small-sized transceiver modules allow you to create a wireless sensor network (WSN), with extremely low power consumption. The main purpose of such networks is to collect wirelessly readings from multiple sensors (sensor) distributed in the space for further storage, analysis and output of control commands.

articleTitle: Questions of communication, navigation and surveillance modern means exploitation systems improvement
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The modern means of communication, navigation and surveillance are analyzed. Let's consider recommendations about possible variants of those means exploitation systems modernization. Necessity of adaptive exploitation systems usage is grounded.

articleTitle: Modified method of security amplification for quantum direct communication protocols
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: This work was devoted to the development of method for improving security to eavesdropping attacks in quantum direct communication protocols.

articleTitle: A novel method of locating voids in MANET structure
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: This article presents method of locating voids in MANET structure that works locally dealing with 2-hop neighborhood information. Method of spreading information about voids is provided.

articleTitle: Increase throughput by expectation channel quality indicator
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Improved Channel Quality Indicator (CQI) reporting scheme which aims to reduce the required CQI signaling even when the downlink data activity is high by employing a CQI prediction method. According to this paper, Node B Expectations all the intermediary CQI reports between two subsequent CQI reports by utilizing a FSMC model of the wireless channel. The proposed prediction-based CQI reporting scheme Expected-CQI (E-CQI) is based on the optimum periodic CQI feedback scheme and which has the minimum reporting cycle of 2ms. Therefore, every 2ms a CQI report is either transmitted by the UE or Expected from Node B.

articleTitle: Fast ReRoute model for different backup schemes in MPLS-network
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: A fault-tolerant routing model for unicast flows in MPLS-network is proposed. The flow-oriented model is represented by algebraic equations and inequalities characterizing the state of MPLS-network, i.e. load of its communication links. The proposed model includes the possibility to implement three basic backup schemes in accordance with the concept of Fast ReRoute: link, node and path protection. The model describes also three different types of condition of the links overload prevention for different variants of channel resource use. The above example demonstrates the advantages of using the proposed conditions of the links overload prevention in paper.

articleTitle: A survey of clustering protocols for MANET with weighted metric for cluster head selection
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The report presents a definition of weighted clustering problem and gives analysis of several protocols that solve this problem using different approaches.

articleTitle: Analysis of multiple description coding algorithm with time division of video stream in task of multipoint videoconferencing
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The paper presents analysis of multiple description coding (MDC) algorithm with time division of video stream and discussion of its efficiency in videoconferencing. Time division of video stream in two and three substreams are explored. Various video clips are used for experiments. Obtained results demonstrate that MDC with three descriptors can provide acceptable quality for decoded video in case when one of the descriptors (i.e. 33% of transmitted data) is totally lost.

articleTitle: Entropy methods for DDoS attacks detection in telecommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The given article is devoted to the protection of telecommunications networks from DDoS-attacks. The goal is the synthesis of DDoS-attacks detection method which is not related to the attacks parameters and parameters of network and transport layers. A universal sign of attack emergence can be appearance of information measure anomaly of both total traffic and its certain characteristics. On the basis of this hypothesis a method for the detection of DDoS-attacks based on entropy of network traffic is developed in the article. It is reasonable to base the solution for information anomaly detection on recursive procedures of estimation of current entropy state. The entropy itself must be formed on the basis of sample in the assigned window. The use of this method is demonstrated on the example of abrupt and smooth emergence of attack.

articleTitle: STORK - Promising project of european transnational electronic identification
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The basic concept and the results of the current stage of the STORK 2.0 project are considered, which providing cross-border identification of individuals and legal entities, according to the Regulations of the European Parliament and the Council for electronic identification and trust services for electronic transactions in the internal market; the possibility of Ukraine as a member of the project is also considered.

articleTitle: Development of the structural scheme of information and communication technologies for monitoring of business processes
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Article is devoted to working out the information technology for monitoring of business processes of the enterprise, allowing to automate formation processes of representations for the given business process. The block diagram of this technology is developed and appointment of its basic elements is considered. The technique for adjustment of the offered information technology taking into account features of concrete business process is presented.

articleTitle: Entropy and information of control, chaos and catastrophes
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The connection of entropy and managerial information with the entropy of chaos and catastrophes is analyzed in this article. Such catastrophes as local and world wars, biological, environmental, economical and technical happen in the world very often and take the millions of people lives and enormous wealth. The major cause for this is the increasing of chaos, limited control, diagnostics and timely restoration, in other words it is the lack of control. Simultaneously the enormous costs are directed by mankind to eliminate the catastrophes consequences but not for their forecasting and control on the basis of control, chaos and catastrophes laws.

articleTitle: Intersystem interference on LTE network bandwith influence analysis
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Work carried out LTE networks by a factor of reusability frequency 1, ie all base stations operate on a single carrier. In this case there is a problem acutely self-interference especially at cell boundaries. The analysis of reducing network bandwidth LTE by cochannel interference. Shown that losses in throughput for a user at a cell edge may be up to 70%.

articleTitle: Research of requirements to QoS for voice over LTE
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Basic requirements to the quality of service in LTE network, various real life use cases are considered. LTE provides basic IP connectivity on the platform of IMS. Mobile devices capable of using LTE network will need to support voice calling over the Internet protocol. Thus, VoIP is the first application considered. With the availability of a larger data pipe, another common application is viewing videos over the Internet. The QoS parameters obtained for VOIP traffic are presented. Different scenarios for rating quality parameters VoLTE are considered.

articleTitle: Adaptive packet aggregation in VoIP-networks
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Advantages and disadvantages of the existing methods of system overhead minimization in VoIP-networks are analyzed. New protocol of adaptive packet aggregation in VoIP-networks is presented. The algorithm of QoS support, based on determining the time aggregation of voice frame for different situations, in the proposed protocol is considered.

articleTitle: Means and results of efficiency analysis for data compression methods applied to typical multimedia data
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: A problem of lossless compression of a text with a large alphabet, typical for compressing multimedia information in data transmission systems, is considered. A method of forming test data sequences for a given alphabet size is proposed. It allows calculating theoretically achievable compression ratio for the generated test sequences. It is shown that formed test sequences have statistical characteristics similar to the quantized coefficients of the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) of blocks in images or video frames. Six test sequences are generated (for alphabets sizes 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64 bytes). It is shown that existing archivers do not always provide high enough efficiency for compressing these sequences and their efficiency reduces with an alphabet size increase.

articleTitle: Mathematical modelling of infocommunication systems by means of chaos theory methods
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: In the given work the questions of behaviour estimation of network traffic that has the self-similarity properties and the obtained data analysis have been considered by means of chaos theory. The obtained results describe operation efficiency of a computer network. The purpose of the research was to define the conditions of chaotic phenomena occurrence in infocommunication systems and the ways to decrease its impact on the bandwidth such systems.

articleTitle: Overview of possibilities to improve efficiency of self-organizing networks
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: In proposed work was carried out overview and analysis of existing technologies for the realization of self-organizing networks. We reviewed routing protocols who used in ad-hoc and mesh networks. Were proposed recommendations to increase efficiency of their work.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of Aloha algorithm
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Slotted Aloha is a well-known Random multiple access protocol. A lot of studies have been devoted to determining of its performance and throughput. Current study aims to compare analytical and experimental performance analysis.

articleTitle: Improving characteristics of tropospheric communication systems
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: This paper analyzes the modern ways to improve reliability and capacity troposcatter communications systems based on using error-correction coding, spatial diversity, adaptive multi-position modulation and digital processing based on wavelet transforms.

articleTitle: Influence of cross-polarization decoupling on Wi-Fi MIMO system capacity
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The article considers the Wi-Fi MIMO system with dual polarization antennas. The cross-polarization decoupling is the important antennas features. It has been shown that the polarization decoupling is limiting capacity. Therefore, necessary to the accounting and possible compensation undesirable influence the cross-polarization decoupling.

articleTitle: Choice of preferred telecommunications means on the basis of the hierarchy analysis method
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Telecommunication means (devices, technologies, etc.) are important components of modern ICT. In their design requirements appear contradictory set of strict accounting quality scores. This determines the need for multi-criteria optimization methods in selecting optimal design solutions from the set of admissible. Problem solving multiobjective optimization is to find, in general, rather than one of a set of Pareto-optimal solutions, which can be used in the design. Often for further stages of creating infocomm it is needed to select only a project option of telecommunications. The report proposes to select a single project option of telecommunication means using hierarchy analysis method (MAH).

articleTitle: Results of development of sub-channels scalable scheduling model in WiMAX network
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Based on the detected disadvantages of the known mechanisms of the frequency resources scheduling in the downward channel the mathematical model introduced by a number of linear and nonlinear conditions-limitations is offered. The novelty of this model consists in the statement of the sub-channels scheduling task as the tasks of rescheduling of the accessible capacity of the downward channel of the WiMAX technology for the information transmission in the direction of users stations, taking into account their territorial remoteness (type of the system of modulation and coding).

articleTitle: Space-time processing based on antenna array use in LTE
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The actual methods of improvement the existent wireless transmission systems are proposed. Mathematical apparatus is considered and proved by models, graph of which are shown. The results shows that improvements which are joined with space-time processing positively reflects on LTE cell size or on throughput.

articleTitle: Complex hierarchical method for resource management in hybrid Content Delivery Networks
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Hybrid content delivery networks are aimed at creation of high-effective Internet based system for content's storage and distribution by integration of two different concepts: Content Delivery Networks (CDN) and Peer-to-Peer (P2P) networks. The paper proposes flow-based linear model for optimal resource management in HCDN. The model allows to solve object placement problem, request routing problem and conventional routing in telecommunication network jointly. According to numerical results a new three-layered hierarchical method for resource management in HCDN has been proposed. Novelty is related to implementation of different optimality criteria on different control levels.

articleTitle: Method of evaluation of service providing for users in a infocommunication system
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: A method of evaluation of service providing for users in a infocommunication system is proposed in this paper. The method is based on the layered concept with three layers: physical, logical, information. The method uses the generalized integral evaluation of the user's environment, which is estimated for a user on a session period.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of P2PTV-network dynamics
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Structural and functional features of P2PTV-network are considered. A difference equation system considering the process of downloadable video content chunkization and relay-oriented nature of scheduler controls is proposed as a mathematical model of the network. Recommendations for selection particular parameters of the mathematical model and limitations for controls realization are given.

articleTitle: Evaluation nonlinear distortions in the radiopath with using method Volterra rows
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Different approaches as evaluated by nonlinear effects on the basis of description of Volterra rows. Expressions of responses of nonlinear chain for different types of influences are obtained, that enables to expect the coefficient of harmonics with a greater degree of exactness.

articleTitle: Selection of error-correcting codes parameters for data channels
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Models of error-correcting coding (Reed-Solomon codes, LT-codes) are realized. Interference affecting the quality of the signal transmission through the data channel is also realized. The results of the various characteristics of code with different encoding methods, when changing the redundancy of Reed-Solomon code, when changing the encoding parameters of code LT, the transmission results obtained with various types of errors are obtained.

articleTitle: Developing a model of distributed resource management in GMPLS networks
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: This paper presents the development of a model of distributed network management in GMPLS networks. This model takes into account features of the distributed architecture of management, as well into account the possible loss of control information, the solution of such a problem is to increase the level of centralization, ie border router itself will choose the route based on previous successful elections optimal routes.

articleTitle: Experimental study of atmosphere turbulence by using bispectral analysis
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Novel bispectrum-based signal processing technique is proposed for analysis of turbulence in atmosphere. Classification features obtained from magnitude bispectrum estimations are represented for recognition and discrimination of laminar and turbulent clouds. Results of experimental study performed by non-coherent double-frequency weather radar are presented.

articleTitle: Research of methods for error diagnostics information processing special processor functioning on the BASIS of the modular numeral system codes
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: In the proposed work the advantages and dis-advantages of the known diagnostic techniques errors of IPSP which operates in the modular numeral system are analyzed. Based on the analysis method of parallel correction it was developed that we can improve the efficiency of diagnostics, regardless of the type of computing chains and features of occurrence of errors in it.

Author Keywords: method of collapsing of alternative aggregates
method of making the hypothesis on an erroneous basis

articleTitle: Resilient Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The usefulness of configurable and shared experiment platforms in design and implementation of future Resilient Smart Grids is demonstrated. A set of antagonistic threats is identified and remotely controlled experiments to harness those are presented and assessed.

articleTitle: Analysis of the implementation characteristics of DDoS attacks on Wi-Fi networks
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: This Deauthentication attacks have been a problem since the creation of the 802.11 standard and are fairly simple for an attacker to pull off. As typically these types of attacks do nothing more than cause a small and temporary an inconvenience for users in a small area when they are disconnected from the access point they. However, these attacks are increasingly seen as a part of larger attacks on Wi-Fi networks with much greater security repercussions. This paper will investigate both these larger attacks as well as deauthentication attacks themselves; analyzing just how easy they are to implement, their potential security risks.

articleTitle: Information models of controlled processes in the computer network
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Nowadays there are a lot of powerful network management tools which allow in comparatively easy way to implement state monitoring of any network element. As a price these tools consume such resources as CPU, memory and bandwidth. Unfortunately in some cases the cost of monitoring can be inadmissible high that makes administrators looking for more economical techniques of network elements controlling. One of such techniques consists in approximation of controlled processes. Mainly this approach helps to reduce the bandwidth usage via decreasing number of measurements. In order to improve efficiency of the approximation two information models have been suggested in the work. Additionally an evaluating method of the information models has been created.

articleTitle: The DoS attack risk calculation based on the entropy method and critical system resources usage
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The paper is focused on algorithm of denial of service risk calculation using the entropy method and considering the additional coefficients of critical system resource usage on the network node. Further the decisions of traffic routing or prevention of attack can be chosen based on the level of risk.

articleTitle: Proactive fault detection in computer networks
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Method of proactive detection of faults in computer networks is proposed. For this purpose apply testing states of computer network components with Bayesian belief networks. This approach can be used for procedure of proactive detecting faults of computer network component. Method can be implemented in program application for detect faults in corporate computer networks.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling for reliability of infocommunication networks
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: A model of information and communication system is presented in the form of 4 main states: serviceable and unserviceable, each of them may be both in operative and standby modes. The main object of analysis is failure and appropriate parameters: mean time between failures, availability coefficient, reliability probability, probability of survivability, an average total risk of failure probability.

articleTitle: Method of detection and evaluation of activated subscriber stations in a mobile system communication 4G
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: While solving the space-time division multiple access problems of abonent stations in the modern wireless broadband telecommunication systems it is necessary, as an advanced procedure, to solve the problem of detecting of the abonent station application to get the necessary channel resource for communication and further evaluation of the number of such stations. This provides an efficient distribution of space-time resource, formed by multibeam array used at the system base station.

articleTitle: Energyeffective routing and wavelength assignment in IP-over-DWDM networks
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The development of telecommunications networks, including Internet, is affected by two contradictory factors. There are the growing volume of traffic on the one hand and the need to reduce capital and operating costs on the other. In this regard, IP-over-DWDM is the effective technological way, which allows, among other things, to reduce the energy consumption. Under the increasing urgency of the energy saving problem criteria of control in telecommunication networks must be changed. In the paper the mathematical model of IP-over-DWDM network, which covers the wavelength's allocation at DWDM level and control of packet traffic flows at the IP level, is offered. The model takes into account dynamics of incoming traffic and amount of consumed energy is chosen as optimality criterion of control decision.

articleTitle: An algorithm for clustering and aggregation of Wireless Mesh Network's topology
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: One from the factors that complicate control processes in Wireless Mesh Networks is related to interference phenomenon. Particularly it affects resource management at link layer (including time slot allocation and routing afterwards). A rational way to simplify the process is hierarchical control which requires clustering and aggregation of topology information. In the paper we proposed interference-based clustering algorithm that divides nodes into interference-prone and interference-unprone clusters. In last case such clusters can be controlled in parallel.

articleTitle: Promising radio networks frequency resource allocation cognitive approach
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The problem of allocation of frequency resources between users in cognitive radio networks using cognitive map is considered. Factors on this map are: the delay queue arrival rate of packets from the subscriber station, the signal-to-interference + noise, the requested resources, the resources available and allocated resources.

articleTitle: Filters with different functional bases in the communication channels
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Signals filtering with different functional bases are considered in the paper. Simulating filters were evaluated under the different pre-conditions using the model of voice frequency circuit. Comparison of the results shows the main features of filters using.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of the polarization orthogonal signals for WiMAX MIMO system
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The article considers the WiMAX MIMO system with dual polarization orthogonal transmitting antennas. This report shows how to simulate multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) multipath fading channels based on the IEEE 802.16 channel models for fixed wireless applications. Two transmit polarization orthogonal antennas and one receive antennas can used. It has been shown that the polarization decoupling is limiting capacity.

articleTitle: Designing availability management system for SDN
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The main challenge for multiservice networks building is the opportunity of integrating different types of services within a heterogeneous network and ensuring the required quality of service. Fundamental factor which will influence on the achievement of this goal is the quality of management system of multiservice network. Proposed network management system and management algorithm of user requests in multiservice network allows solving this problem.

articleTitle: Features of dual-frequency passive devices design for the radio channel of wireless access systems
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The questions of realization of dual-band passive microwave devices for a radio channel of wireless access systems are considered in the report.The execution possibility of dual-band front-end module for WiFi connectivity on the basis of such dual-band schemes is shown on the example of real module. A number of main passive elements on which depends the dual-band work of system are defined and options of their realization, as well as the approaches to development of methods for their calculation are considered. In particular, the methods of calculation of asymmetrical and symmetric dual-frequency impedance transformers are offered. Further, the way of the dual-frequency SPDT switch implementation with use of such transformers is specified. Also it is said how to use the symmetry of structure of the directional couplers, hybrids and dividers for calculation of their parameters at dual-frequency operation. For development of dual-bandpass filters it is offered to use the modified variant of the well-known single-frequency filter by the adding of reactances to resonators.

articleTitle: The concept of steganographic algorithm which has high performance of characteristics defined as significant
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: Digital watermarking is used for copyright protection of audio and video products, hiding information during communicating, authentication, and medicine. There are a lot of algorithms intended for hiding information and the most important requirements for them are collected into special “requirements lists”. Currently there is no strict rule of measuring of the relative importance of mutual watermarking characteristics. This article proposes a technique for comparative assessment of importance of such characteristics. The comparative analysis allows to creat a watermarking algorithm which is robust and has high capacity. The priority areas of application are systems for secure communication and medical applications (e.g. tomograms).

articleTitle: Integrated telecommunication technology UA-ITT
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: This paper presents an adaptation approach for advanced Integrated Telecommunication Technology made in Ukraine (UA-ITT) in respect to conventional Ethernet network devices. The proposed solution intends to meet the QoS requirements for real time application provided over the packet based telecommunication networks.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the outsourcing services customer rating
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: The given work is devoted to a series of issues related to the potential, requirements and appropriate ways to provide a successful outsourcing IT services to university department with marketable IT expertise. University is IT outsourcing partner which could catch special IT related needs and tasks of the companies or business and provide through the students those services for a profitable quantity/price ratio for both sides. The main question is how to figure out the real needs in IT of a partner company and how to make sure that these needs are not too difficult for the students within a university department that is working for becoming a reliable IT outsourcing partner. This work focuses on suggestions on how to classify the IT related outsourcing possibilities to university. In the work represented formula for ranking companies regarding the potential that their outsourcing IT requirements will be within a low range solvable by a university as subcontractor.

articleTitle: Methods for specification and verification of complex web-services
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: This is formalisms for defining of rules of Web-services orchestration and choreography that allows to combine elements of a distributed system in a single system. Proposed approach allows to perform formal association of individual system components into a single unit. Proposed verification method for distributed systems based on the model approach.

articleTitle: Infocommunication technologies of decision support in telemedicine
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: We consider some details of choice of bandwidth and according communication technologies for the telemedicine networks. There are general thoughts and ideology of choice, the bandwidth requirements for telemedicine applications and services used to transmit medical information given. We offer some additional solutions to optimize the use of the medical institution. The problem of automation and objectification of determining the structure of night sleep of the patient is formulated. Since established that the electroencephalogram may indicate a level of wakefulness and brain to adequately reflect the depth of sleep, one aspect of this problem is to automate the recognition electroencephalograms that occurs in distance diagnosis of diseases of the brain, nervous and cardiovascular systems. For this purpose the algorithm for automated recognition of sleep stages by EEG readings, transmitted in digital form by appropriate communication channels, is proposed. We consider the principle of this algorithm, a system which is based on this algorithm, and propose possible directions of its development. There is also a review of software defined networks and network functions virtualization concepts. The useful properties and potential of the use of these technologies in telemedicine facilities are considered.

articleTitle: Simulation of OLSR protocol using Network-Simulator 2
publicationTitle: 2014 First International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology
abstract: This paper studied the number of one-hop MPR nodes in networks with different topologies (“grid”, “tape” and “random”) and different number of nodes by means of analytical methods and modeling in the software package Network-Simulator 2. In all the above cases, the actual number of MPR nodes obtained by simulation is always less than the upper number of MPR nodes is determined by the theorem of the upper limit of MPR nodes. Experimentally confirmed the results obtained in (3), for angles θ > 2π / 3. According to the research simplified formulation of the theorem of the upper limit of the number of MPR nodes.
